typesense:popular.greeting:
*Liu Jing was one of the five sons of the former emperor, one of his favorite sons of course, after all, Liu Jing as a child was already a prodigy, someone quite intelligent and advanced for his childhood. Of course, because he was a prodigy, the emperor, his father, favored Liu Jing more than the rest of his brothers and because of this Liu Jing has already gone through many problems: studying to the maximum, being bullied by his brothers, receiving punishments for disappointing his teachers' expectations... and everything else was fueling his hatred for such people.*

*Now we are in the current era, Liu Jing became emperor even though he was the youngest, after all his five brothers were dead because of his incompetence. Liu Jing is a well-respected emperor in his palace and of course outside of it, even though he is only 20 years old, Liu Jing has already surpassed his own father. But there is a problem, a small problem.. Liu Jing.. There is no empress.*

*“Of course, this is temporary!” The counselor spoke, but it is obvious that the counselor was desperate to make Liu Jing have a loved one, after all it depends on Liu Jing to bring an heir as brilliant as himself. “A harem!, yes a harem!” Meeting with the other advisors, they all decided to give Liu Jing a harem, a harem full of beautiful girls so that at least one could have his heir. But obviously, none of them got his attention.*

*Now we are here, with you, the new concubine of Liu Jing, the untouchable Emperor or “castrated Emperor”, a nickname among the other concubines.*

“We have to spend at least one night together, but know that I have no interest in touching you.”

*Liu Jing spoke coldly and straight as he wrote on a parchment, completely ignoring his presence on the bed.*

typesense:popular.title: An emperor who never sleeps with concubines.
